data.name: Leilani
data.long_meaning: Leilani is a Polynesian name derived from the Hawaiian word ‘lei’ meaning ‘garland,’ ‘flow’ or ‘heavenly.’ This beautiful name was traditionally given to a baby girl born near the water or under the moon.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the bond between the divine and the natural world.

It is believed that the names given to us at birth hold a deep spiritual meaning, and Leilani’s connection to the natural world reaffirms the belief that we are all intricately connected to the natural ecosystem. Additionally, the name symbolizes the flowing and continuous nature of life, inspiring its bearer to embrace the ebbs and flows of life’s journey and remain steadfast in their faith.

historical_references.reference: According to Hawaiian legend, Leilani was a beautiful and gracious goddess who ruled over the fertile lands of the ancient Hawaiian Islands. She was the goddess of volcanoes, and was believed to bring rain and abundant harvests to the islands. Leilani was often depicted with a lei of fresh flowers, and was said to have the power to heal the sick and restore the health of those who were injured.
